title: Single Side Panel Tree Mechanism
description: Remove the divergent React-component side-panel registry in the platform React renderer so every side panel can only be a declarative tree registered and rendered through one central mechanism.
summary: Removed the renderer-level React sidePanelBodyByKey map and duplicate registerSidePanelBody. The platform renderer now re-exports the core declarative registerSidePanelBody/unregisterSidePanelBody. sideTabsToPanelTabs only maps getSidePanelBodyFactory hits to DeclarativeSidePanelTreeDefinition or a missing-panel tree — the legacy ReactBody wrapper escape hatch is gone. Tests updated to use declarative tree builders; added coverage for sideTabsToPanelTabs, non-tree rejection, settings tab tree definitions, and PlatformView tree markup. Verification script confirms settings tabs and non-tree rejection at runtime.
